title: SBL.SourceAdjudication@1
description: One decision by the ORIGINAL SBL PIPD Reader about ONE Source ID. Written by the reader, never by the compiler; checked read-only by `pipd validate --adjudications`. Not a member of the S0 exact-19 contract registry: it is a pre-V2 reader-side family, so registering it would change the ratified family count.

source_id.description: Compiler-native Source ID: SRC-<sha256[:20]> of {file, clause_id, subject sha}.

subject_sha256.description: Digest of the whole pinned subject the clause was cut from.

span.description: [start, end) character offsets into the pinned subject.

clause_sha256.description: Digest of the exact subject bytes at `span` - the binding that stops a decision being pasted onto another clause.

decision.description: The three tokens the compiler is forbidden to produce.

basis.description: The reader's own reason, quoted from the ruling. MUST NOT be a compiler refusal code: a refusal is not a decision.

reader_id.description: Documentation only. Authority comes from `signature`, verified against the committed reader enrollment - never from this string.

reader_identity.description: Legacy/alias field accepted for import. Documentation only.

authority_ref.description: Path or id of the reader's ruling envelope. Documentation only: a path is not a signature.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the reader's decision.

signature.description: The ONLY field that can promote a record out of UNVERIFIED.

payload_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the binding fields. A record edited after signing fails here.
